content: Hello! How can I assist you today regarding the estate account or any recent fund transfers?

Correct, Emily. An email confirmation was sent to emily.sanders17@gmail.com at 9:05 AM today. Please check your inbox and spam folder. It's important to review it promptly as we have a 48-hour window for any transfer verification.
I found the email, thanks. It mentions a transaction ID: 3FZ9-QA21-LK93. Is there anything else I need to do for the legal review?

With transaction ID 3FZ9-QA21-LK93 now confirmed, you're nearly done. The only remaining step is to acknowledge receipt via the secure link provided in your email, please do so before the end of today to avoid processing delays.
Done! I clicked the link and confirmed receipt. Will the next installment for Michael be processed automatically?

Yes, Emily. As long as the IBAN you provided (DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00) remains valid, the next payment for Michael Torres is scheduled for July 28th, and you'll receive advance notice 3 days prior. Let us know if your bank details or contact number (+1-917-555-1842) change to prevent any future delays.
